 JJ Redick addresses alarming Ziaire Williams injury after another Lakers absence 
 2026-10-31 01:50 
 Ziaire Williams is in a "good spot" despite another absence for the Lakers due to a foot injury.
 Credit: ZUMA Press-Scanpix

 The Los Angeles Lakers remain optimistic about Ziaire Williams' progress as he continues to deal with a foot injury.

 Speaking before their Golden State Warriors matchup at the NBA Cup, JJ Redick emphasized that the Lakers are prioritizing caution while managing Williams' injury situation.
 "I think he’s in a good spot. He still has some soreness. We’re just going to have to continue to monitor it," Redick told reporters. "He was in shootaround this morning.
 "Again, just being overly cautious with the amount of games we have to start the season."
 Ziaire Williams still out for Lakers due to foot injury
 Ziaire Williams has been ruled out for the Los Angeles Lakers' Friday clash against the Golden State Warriors due to left foot injury management.
 This marks the second consecutive absence of Williams amid his foot issues.
 Williams has been dealing with left foot complications since the preseason. On the Lakers' end, they can only be more cautious in handling the forward's health and playing time as the season just started.
 The LA's marquee offseason addition at the wing spot, Williams is averaging 11.3 points, 3.0 rebounds, 2.3 assists, and 1.5 steals per game while shooting an efficient 57.1% from the field and 46.7% from three-point range so far for the Lakers.
 For now, the Lakers expect Quentin Grimes, Jake LaRavia, Sandro Mamukelashvili, and Matisse Thybulle to step up with Williams unavailable.
